title: Rust engine: post-action trigger check and claim window entry
description: In finalize_turn(), after execute_action() but before advancing turn, check if the action matches any trigger's on_action. If so, enter claim window: set runtime.claim_window, emit TriggerActivated event, do NOT advance turn. New apply_claim() entry point for submitting claims during an active window. When all eligible players respond, resolve by priority, execute winning claim action, then finalize_turn().
close_reason: Implemented in parallel subagents. All existing tests pass.
